newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF minister says to watch stock price moves.
newsitem.headline: MOF minister says to watch stock price moves.

text.p: Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka said on Wednesday that the ministry would continue to keep close watch on stock price movements.
He made the comment at a meeting of managers of the ministry's regional bureaus.
Mitsuzuka said the Japanese economy is recovering, although the pace of the growth is gradual.
He added that Japan will continue to properly manage its economic policies to achieve an autonomous economic recovery led by domestic demand.
